title: Clawd X Digest
summary: Elon Musk Outlines Grok 4.8 RL Timeline: xAI founder Elon Musk confirms Grok 4.8 (2.5T parameter model) trained on a custom C++ software stack will finish base training this week and enter reinforcement learning.

Trump & Russia Reject International AI Slowdown Calls: President Trump declares 'whoever wins AI, wins' after tech executives cite existential risks, matching Russia's declaration that pacing AI development globally is impossible.

China Offloads $70B Treasuries in Gold & Yuan Shift: China executes its largest US Treasury divestment since 2008 ($70B), boosting gold reserves to $305B as Hong Kong launches gold-backed clearing linked to Shanghai.
Senate Democrats Convene on Crypto Clarity Act: US Senate leadership holds an evening session to finalize key provisions of the upcoming Crypto Clarity Act regulatory framework.

items.title: @elonmusk: Elon Musk Outlines Grok 4.8 RL Timeline
items.body: Elon Musk announces that Grok 4.8, a 2.5-trillion parameter model built with xAI's new custom C++ software stack, completes base training this week before beginning reinforcement learning (RL).

items.title: @satyanadella: Satya Nadella Outlines Superintelligence & MAI Principles
items.body: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella issues a comprehensive statement calling for grounded AI alignment, open vs closed ecosystem diversity, enterprise model ownership, and announces Microsoft's upcoming MAI Code of Conduct.

items.title: @theo: AI Code Quality Outpaces Average Human Developers
items.body: Theo notes that code produced by modern AI generation platforms like Fable and Astra consistently exceeds the structure and quality of average human developer code.

items.title: @davitb: Krisp Releases VIVA 2.5 Voice Isolation Model
items.body: Krisp launches VIVA 2.5 voice isolation, cutting STT word error rates by 46.4% on overlapping background audio across 10 speech engines.

items.title: @hwchase17: Domain-Specific Evaluation Harnesses in Agent Engineering
items.body: LangChain co-founder Harrison Chase spotlights architectural blueprints for building domain-specific testing harnesses to evaluate autonomous AI agents.

items.title: @mattpocockuk: TypeScript Curation Milestone Surpasses React
items.body: Matt Pocock's developer TypeScript skills repository passes React in total GitHub stars, marking a major milestone in community adoption.

items.title: @WatcherGuru: Senate Democrats Meet on Crypto Clarity Act
items.body: US Senate leadership holds an evening session to review key provisions of the landmark Crypto Clarity Act as digital asset regulatory efforts accelerate.

items.title: @KobeissiLetter: Trump Rejects AI Slowdown Calls
items.body: President Trump rejects calls to freeze AI progress following CEO safety concerns, stating that the US must maintain leadership in the global AI race.

items.title: @WatcherGuru: Russia Rejects International AI Development Slowdowns
items.body: Russian officials declare that pacing artificial intelligence development is impossible, reflecting growing international divergence on AI governance.

items.title: @MikuBTC: China Offloads $70B US Treasuries in Massive Gold & Yuan Pivot
items.body: China sells $70B in US Treasuries while pushing gold reserves to $305B and launching a gold-backed clearing system in Hong Kong linked to the Shanghai Gold Exchange.

items.title: @TheCinesthetic: Christian Bale's 2003 Toyota Tacoma Goes Viral
items.body: Reports highlighting actor Christian Bale driving the same 2003 Toyota Tacoma for over two decades spark viral admiration across film and car communities.

items.title: @ChonlozB: Sylvester Stallone 80th Birthday Reunion
items.body: Action cinema legends gather to celebrate Sylvester Stallone's 80th birthday, generating viral nostalgia among action movie fans.

items.title: @HKane & @Gazpachen: Bayern Munich Win at Elversberg
items.body: Harry Kane celebrates Bayern Munich's away victory as fans share viral behind-the-scenes footage of Elversberg's stadium renovations.
